name: images
description: After a prompt is sent, an IMAGES band above the prompt draws each pasted [Image #n] as a half-block thumbnail (macOS sips turns the engine's PNG into a small BMP), with [Image #n] WxH beneath; cleared when the next prompt is sent. A small labelled thumbnail row is also placed in the transcript under the sent prompt. /img shows the last tiles again, /img <n> draws one image of this session, /img on | off | clear, /img under on | off.

size.title: Tile width in columns
size.description: 12, 16, 24 (default) or 32 terminal columns; the height follows the image (half-block rows = columns × height / width / 2, at most 24 rows).

auto.title: Draw a sent prompt's images on their own
auto.description: on (default) or off; /img on | off overrides it and is kept for the next session. /img <n> works either way.

linger.title: How long the row stays
linger.description: turn (default): until the next prompt is sent; 2min: two minutes, or the next prompt if sooner; until-cleared: until /img clear or the clear button.

under.title: Thumbnails under the sent prompt
under.description: on (default) or off: a small labelled row of the sent prompt's images (at most 12 by 6 cells each) placed in the transcript under it. /img under on | off overrides it and is kept for the next session. It does not need the automatic tiles: with auto or /img off, the images are still drawn here, only not in the band.
